corrections.source: I know it's been a while.
corrections.previous_target: 我知道，已经有一阵子了。
corrections.target: 我知道，我们已经很久没说话了。

corrections.source: A little less than that if one considers withering glares a form of speech.
corrections.previous_target: 如果把恶狠狠的瞪视也算作一种说话方式，那就短一些。
corrections.target: 如果把怒目相向也算作交谈，那就没那么久。

corrections.source: I don't. But I'm glad you're counting.
corrections.previous_target: 我不这么算。不过很高兴你还在数。
corrections.target: 我不这么算。不过，很高兴你还在记日子。

corrections.source: In a thousand ways, yes. But each of them pales in comparison to this:
corrections.previous_target: 是的，我有一千种理由恨你。但每一种都比不上这一点：
corrections.target: 是的，我有一千种理由恨你。但都比不上这一种：

corrections.source: I have had my fun in killing you any number of horrid ways. Frightening you. Breaking you...
corrections.previous_target: 我用无数种可怕的方式杀死你，已经尽兴了。恐吓你。让你崩溃……
corrections.target: 用种种骇人的手段杀死你、恐吓你、摧垮你……这些乐子我都享受过了。

corrections.source: You are correct. For at the end of it all, only then did the strangest thing happen. You truly did give up. You lost the fight.
corrections.previous_target: 你说对了。因为直到这一切的最后，最奇怪的事才发生。你确实放弃了。你输掉了这场较量。
corrections.target: 没错。直到最后，最奇怪的事才终于发生：你真的放弃了。你输掉了这场较量。

corrections.source: As you have ceased to be a player in this game these past years, retreating entirely, I find all of Elsinore has merged into one shapeless mass. Boredom has sanded off all the edges.
corrections.previous_target: 这些年来，你彻底退缩，不再参与这场游戏。我发现，整个埃尔西诺已经融成了没有形状的一团。无聊磨平了所有棱角。
corrections.target: 这些年来，你彻底退缩，不再参与这场游戏。在我眼中，整个埃尔西诺都已变得模糊不清，混成了一团。无聊磨平了所有棱角。

corrections.source: Each of its inhabitants is both alive and dead, joyful and grieving, clever and cruel, all at once. For I can no longer remember what is true any longer.
corrections.previous_target: 这里的每个人都同时活着又死去，欢喜又悲伤，聪明又残忍。因为我已经再也记不清什么是真的了。
corrections.target: 这里的每个人都同时活着又死去，欢喜又悲伤，聪明又残忍——我已经记不清，究竟什么才是真的了。

corrections.source: I fear I have gone quite mad, Ophelia.
corrections.previous_target: 奥菲莉娅，我恐怕已经彻底疯了。
corrections.target: 奥菲莉娅，我怕是已经彻底疯了。

corrections.source: Perhaps I never was sane to begin with. Perhaps it's always been this way. Or perhaps this will always be our shared delusion, you and I.
corrections.previous_target: 也许我从一开始就没清醒过。也许一直都是这样。又或者，这永远都会是你我共有的妄想。
corrections.target: 也许我从来就没正常过。也许一直都是这样。又或者，这永远都会是你我共同的妄想。

corrections.source: They say love is that sort of thing. A shared delusion. I wouldn't know. I've never been in love.
corrections.previous_target: 人们说爱情就是这样。一种共同的妄想。我不知道。我从没爱过谁。
corrections.target: 人们说，爱情就是这样——两个人共同的妄想。我也不懂。我从没爱上过谁。

corrections.source: The Book came to me for a reason. It chose me. Or it was granted to me. Why?
corrections.previous_target: 那本书来到我手里，是有原因的。它选择了我。或者，是谁把它赐给了我。为什么？
corrections.target: 那本书来到我手里，是有原因的。它选择了我。又或者，是谁将它赐给了我。为什么？

corrections.source: Why, indeed, if my fate was merely to become trapped in my own creation like a fool?
corrections.previous_target: 如果我的命运只是像个傻瓜一样，被困在自己创造的东西里，那究竟是为什么？
corrections.target: 如果我的命运仅仅是像个傻瓜一样，被困在自己创造的一切之中，那这一切究竟是为了什么？

corrections.source: I have let all these thoughts crash over me ten thousand times. And there they go, washing away again out to sea.
corrections.previous_target: 这些念头已经像海浪一样，冲击了我一万次。如今它们又退去了，再次流回大海。
corrections.target: 这些念头已如海浪般冲击过我一万次。如今，它们又退去了，再次流回大海。

corrections.source: I don't want to spend eternity at odds with you.
corrections.target: 我不想永远和你敌对下去。

corrections.source: I think we have precious little to say to one another anymore.
corrections.previous_target: 我想，我们如今已经没什么话可对彼此说了。
corrections.target: 我想，我们之间已经没什么可说的了。

limitations: What?为全局共享英文键，此处保留什么，未全局改为干嘛。
